name: Anathema
shortDesc: A game where you collect heresites to play a modified version of chess with an unstoppable faith engine and special faith gimmics, scored 2nd for Jame Gam #59 Game Jam.
longDesc: Anathema is a game made for Jame Gam #59 in which you collece Heresites to play a spin on the game chess where different heresites have different move patterns and abilities, and they interact in many different ways. This game was a huge test for me because i had a very ambitious idea for the jam and i made very modular systems to achieve my goal, I had a lot of experience with that kinda stuff from a previous project anways, but it was all worth it because it ended up scoring 2nd in the jam.
